# Palm Wellness Center

> Integrated primary care, medical weight loss, IV therapy, and rehabilitation in Tampa, FL.

Location: 1004 W Linebaugh Ave Ste A, Tampa, FL 33612
Phone: (813) 443-5370
Languages: English, Spanish
Hours: Monday-Friday 10 AM - 7 PM; Saturday by appointment
